brandComInfo.introduce: 恒天软件成立于2004年，致力于以可靠、专业的数字化技术与产品连接实体与数字世界，推动商业模式的创新与变革。作为浙大网新（上证600797）旗下最大的软件公司，公司提供一站式的技术服务与专业的IT解决方案与产品，业务覆盖大金融、新零售、医疗健康、数字民生等重要领域。恒天软件立足中国，服务全球，现有员工2000余人，总部位于杭州，在上海、合肥、美国波士顿、爱尔兰科克设有分支机构，服务超过300多家国内外客户，其中近百家为世界500强或行业领军公司，与美国道富银行、中国外汇交易中心、上海清算所、中国工商银行、思科、耐克等客户有长期合作关系。

jobInfo.address: 杭州西湖区天堂软件园
jobInfo.postDescription:
Business System Analyst Job Descriptions:
•	Work with external client and internal business users to gather and understand user demands;
•	Analyze and explore business workflow and possible business scenarios; review and evaluate existing business model and future process or solution;
•	Accomplish BA relevant artifacts (e.g. functional specification, user stories, wireframe model/data mapping, user guide) to accurately capture user and system requirements;
 
Preferred Qualifications:
•	3 years’ experience of analyst role in software development, financial or data research industry
•	Fluent verbal & written English communication and strong interpersonal skills
•	Good understanding of software development
•	Knowledge of financial products.
•	Strong analytical and problem solving skills
 
Experience in any of below is highly desirable:
•	Participation in agile development working model.
•	Good tech skills; database tools
•	Passed CFA level 1 examination
•	Major in Financial or IT related, or both
